name: Career Counselling
summary: We help students decide career options depending on their past academic records, work experience and future aspirations.
description:
The first conversation is about direction, not destinations. We look at what you have studied, what you have done since, and what you want the next few years to lead to.

Getting this stage right is what makes every later decision — country, institution, programme — follow from something rather than from a brochure.
howWeHelp: A structured review of your academic record and work experience
Career options discussed against your own aspirations, not a shortlist of products
An honest view of which directions your profile currently supports

processSteps.title: Share your background
processSteps.description: Transcripts, test scores and any work experience.

processSteps.title: Talk through the options
processSteps.description: Where your record can realistically take you.

processSteps.title: Agree a direction
processSteps.description: So the country and course decisions that follow have a basis.

name: University Selection
summary: We assist students in shortlisting and deciding on countries and universities based on their past profiles, needs and career goals.
description: A shortlist is only useful if it is built around your profile. We work through countries and institutions against your academic record, your budget and what you want the qualification to do for you.
howWeHelp: Countries compared on their education systems, entry requirements and costs
Institutions shortlisted against your actual profile rather than a ranking table
The trade-offs made explicit, including where a choice is ambitious

processSteps.title: Set the criteria
processSteps.description: What you need from the country, the institution and the city.

processSteps.title: Build the shortlist
processSteps.description: With the reasoning attached to each option.

processSteps.title: Decide together
processSteps.description: You choose; our job is to make the choice an informed one.

name: University Application
summary: We aid students in creating error-free applications. Any shortcoming in the application process can delay the entire process and result in possible rejection.
description:
Most avoidable rejections and delays come from the application itself: a statement that answers the wrong question, a reference that arrives late, a form field left incomplete.

We work through each application before it is submitted.
howWeHelp: Every form checked for completeness before submission
Statements of purpose reviewed against what the institution actually asks
References requested early and followed up
Deadlines tracked across your whole shortlist

processSteps.title: Prepare
processSteps.description: Documents assembled and the statement drafted.

processSteps.title: Review
processSteps.description: A full check against each institution’s requirements.

processSteps.title: Submit and track
processSteps.description: Filed on time, then followed through to the decision.

name: Scholarship Help
summary: We guide students in applying for various scholarships and financial aid.
description:
Scholarship opportunities are more often lost to deadlines than to competition. We identify what your profile is eligible for and build those applications into your timeline from the start.

We cannot promise an award, and we will not suggest otherwise.
howWeHelp: Eligibility checked against institutional and external awards
Funding deadlines mapped alongside your admission deadlines
Applications reviewed before they are submitted

processSteps.title: Check eligibility
processSteps.description: What you can realistically apply for.

processSteps.title: Plan the timeline
processSteps.description: Funding deadlines usually fall before admission ones.

processSteps.title: Apply
processSteps.description: Prepared and reviewed like any other application.

name: Visa Assistance
summary: We offer expert visa guidance in various domains such as studies, tourism and business.
description:
We help you assemble a complete and internally consistent application, and explain what each stage of the process expects of you.

We are a consultancy, not an immigration authority. We do not make visa decisions and we do not guarantee outcomes. We will also not assist with any application that misrepresents your position.
howWeHelp: A document checklist specific to your destination and purpose
Your application read for internal consistency before it is filed
Each stage of the process explained in advance
Interview preparation where one is required

processSteps.title: Checklist
processSteps.description: Exactly what your destination requires from you.

processSteps.title: Assemble
processSteps.description: Documents gathered and checked against one another.

processSteps.title: Final review
processSteps.description: A last read before you submit.

name: Pre- and Post-Departure Sessions
summary: We conduct pre- and post-departure sessions with our clients to facilitate their transition to overseas countries.
description: The weeks either side of departure are where most practical problems appear, usually because nobody planned the unglamorous parts. We go through them with you — and we stay reachable after you have arrived.
howWeHelp: Accommodation options compared, including the institution’s own
Travel, insurance and arrival planned in the right order
Banking, mobile connectivity and registration covered
A follow-up session after you arrive, not just before you leave

processSteps.title: Before you fly
processSteps.description: Accommodation, travel, insurance and finances settled.

processSteps.title: Arrival briefing
processSteps.description: What to expect in your first week.

processSteps.title: After you land
processSteps.description: A post-departure session once you are settling in.
